description: Structured-output checks for the initial engineering teammate roles. Scores format and explicit rubric signals; it is not a complete measure of engineering quality.

input.requirements: Design a small multi-tenant service that stores customer projects and lets an authenticated project member list only that project's records. Include durable writes and a paginated list endpoint.
input.constraints: PostgreSQL, FastAPI, tenant identity comes from authenticated membership, and every list endpoint must be bounded.

input.specification: Add a FastAPI endpoint to create a project note with a required title and body. Reject blank titles, cap the body at 20,000 characters, and return the created record.
